mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_model (id, tenant_id, provider_id, model_key, display_name, description, source, enabled, is_free, capabilities_json, generation_defaults_json, secret_id, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{providerId}, #{modelKey}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{source}, #{enabled}, #{isFree}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{generationDefaultsJson}, #{secretId}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_model SET display_name = #{entity.displayName}, description = #{entity.description}, source = #{entity.source}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, is_free = #{entity.isFree}, capabilities_json = #{entity.capabilitiesJson}, generation_defaults_json = #{entity.generationDefaultsJson}, secret_id = #{entity.secretId}, updated_at = #{entity.updatedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND tenant_id = #{entity.tenantId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL
